grid.heading: Twelve pieces, one local-first practice.
grid.intro: Move between guided-meditation authoring, measured speech, live interpreting, a voice companion, lyric video, delivery validation, keeping a Downloads folder empty, and the small field tools that support all of them, on one voice and one speech engine they share.

contact.heading: If something looks wrong, say so
contact.note: There is no analytics here and no crash reporter, so a failure has no way of reaching me on its own.

projects.name: Gateway Forge
projects.blurb: Assemble guided sessions and keep published maps beside what was actually found.

projects.name: Voice Forge
projects.blurb: A transparent Piper workbench for timing, pronunciation, and honest audio export.

projects.name: Protoke
projects.blurb: Karaoke and narration video with a vector visor face that mouths every word.

projects.name: Media Preflight
projects.blurb: Check a finished file against where it is going, and correct it without touching the original.

projects.name: siphon
projects.blurb: Fetch from a link or convert what you already have, without re-encoding what it does not have to.

projects.name: auto-sort
projects.blurb: Empty the Downloads funnel into structure the folder taught it, and undo any of it.

projects.name: Interpreter
projects.blurb: Hear the table in English a few seconds behind, cut at the end of each thought, on your own phone.

projects.name: companion-core
projects.blurb: A local voice companion for Mac, iPhone and iPad, with a protogen LED-visor face.

projects.name: tools-core
projects.blurb: Small utilities for audio inspection, corpus work, authoring, and repeatable checks.

projects.name: voice-polyglot
projects.blurb: Teaching one small voice to speak eight languages, and releasing it for every app that speaks.

projects.blurb: The speech engine the apps share: espeak-ng, the phonemizer and Piper inference, from one source.
